[img]https://i.imgur.com/s2OyOeW.png[/img]   [b]Celebrate the feast of the Winter Star with a new item at Pierre's![/b]
[b]Wrapping Paper appears in his stock after you receive the Secret Friend mail.[/b]
Pierre sells it until the end of the year, so stock up while you can!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tro3S7H.png[/img]   Use [b]Wrapping Paper[/b] to wrap-up items in your inventory into a colourful present.
Place them around your home as decorations, or give them to your friends.
Choose from 16+ colourful styles when wrapping your gifts!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vjDXCIH.png[/img]   [b]Wrapping Paper[/b] works in singleplayer, but it's made for multiplayer!
You can wrap-up any items you like, with any number of them inside.
Your friends can open any gifts you've placed on the floor. Click on a gift to tear it open!
Noone can see what's inside a gift except the person who wrapped it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ykgRbMA.png[/img]   [b]Wrapped Gifts[/b] can be gifted to villagers in town at any time of year.
Giving a [b]Wrapped Gift[/b] gives a little extra friendship in addition to what's inside!
You can still only give 2 gifts per week, as usual. Make them count!
Perfect for birthdays and Winter Star presents.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s2OyOeW.png[/img]   [b]Fully gamepad-ready menu![/b]
Use whatever controller you like when wrapping gifts.
Navigate with the dpad or thumbsticks, shoulders, and buttons.
[color=#e69138][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tro3S7H.png[/img]   You can't give villagers any items they couldn't normally be gifted![/b][/color]
Gifts holding a stack of items will only give one to villagers, and return the rest to you.
If you mess up your gift, you can set it down and rip it open yourself to get the item back.
Have fun giving your friends your best Straw Hats and Unmilled Rice Juice!
